runtime.proofMode: Read-only fingerprint in the same isolated container after all final public repository commands completed; no source mutation or rebuild is performed by this proof.

browserConfiguration.policy: Use the actual pinned Playwright GPU default for the native runner: permit software WebGL, omit its contradictory disable-gpu switch. No case filter, timeout, assertion or source change.

crossPlatformSource.explanation: Raw fingerprints preserve the original platform records. The input collector sorts native absolute paths before normalizing separators: Windows orders catalogStyles.ts before catalog/display.tsx, whereas Linux orders the directory first. After sorting the recorded repository-relative paths with the same code-point order, every path and SHA is identical. No source record is omitted or altered.

auditIntegrity.historyAndBaselineApproval: Historical failed runs remain indexed; no designCoverage promotion or historical baseline approval is claimed.

sourceBoundary: Complete Linux public verification and production build are bound to their exact P1 snapshot. The only later source change is explicit native observer teardown in the table keyboard test; its complete Linux package check is bound to P2, with all product and site artifact bytes unchanged. Complete Windows public verification is also bound to P2. Every rendering/test source path and content SHA matches the Linux follow-up; raw fingerprints preserve native path ordering, with a separate strict canonical comparison. Review bookkeeping is excluded from rendering identity; original source versions and failures remain preserved.
priorWindowsFailure: Earlier Windows attempts retained a LineEdit geometry assertion read before ResizeObserver delivery, a nested-task temporary-directory EPERM, and a 45-second native date-journey timeout. Final checks wait for natural layout delivery, use a writable task-local temporary directory and await native user events separately from layout settlement. Every behavior assertion remains, and final public check outcomes are recorded above.

testSourceChanges.scope: Only three test fixtures changed after the final visual source snapshot. Date user events are awaited directly with a separate natural layout settlement; bounded long journeys use 90 seconds. Table cell-editor tests explicitly unmount their owned views and drain finite queued observer delivery, while strict recurring-frame leak checks remain enabled. Geometry, trusted input, scroll, focus, Worker/GPU and pixel assertions remain. Product implementation, examples, dependency metadata and generated sources are unchanged.

launchFailures: Before the actual final run, wrapper attempts encountered Windows argument length, an omitted review-navigation file, and container entrypoint/setup issues. Those attempts did not complete the unified check and are not counted as passes or visual coverage.
nativeBrowserSetup: The native runner discovers conventional executable paths and does not read CRAB_TEST_BROWSER_PATH. The first native attempt disabled GPU without the software WebGL option used by the pinned Playwright build; it timed out during binding cleanup. Headful alone produced 18 failures. Explicitly selecting the same pinned binary with the published GPU defaults passes all 107 original cases. Final Linux public checks discover that validated wrapper through owned disposable-container aliases. No assertion, case filter, timeout or source changed for this alignment.
